name: Tryo Chat — Chatbot for WooCommerce
author: tryosoft

sections.description:
Tryo Chat is a lightweight chat widget that adds to your WooCommerce store without any extra coding.

Lite version features:

  • A chatbot window where visitors can search products by name/keyword
  • Automatic email notification to the store owner when a product isn’t found
  • Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) list, manageable from the admin panel
  • Support request form (emails the admin with name, email, message, page, IP, and browser info)
  • Appearance settings: position, primary color, light/dark theme, custom icon
  • Option to fully hide the widget on mobile/desktop, smart visibility (URL-based show/hide)
  • Responsive interface for desktop and mobile
  • Showcase: list featured/on-sale products directly in the chat
  • Add to cart directly from chat, plus a cart view
  • Simple form builder: multiple custom forms, email delivery to multiple recipients
  • Export/import settings and FAQs as JSON, white label (hide branding) option
  • CSV export for support requests and form submissions
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Go to the “Tryo Chat” menu to configure your settings.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • New: the Pro-only feature areas (AI Chat, Knowledge Base, GPT Modules, Bargaining Bot, Live Chat, Multi-Channel, Retargeting) now appear in the admin panel as tabs with a “PRO” badge. Each shows what the feature does and a link to upgrade. They keep no settings and store no data, and are replaced by the real feature screens when Tryo Chat Pro is installed.
  • Updated the bundled Turkish translation.

2.0.0

  • The plugin’s default language is now English. Turkish ships as a bundled translation, so Turkish-language sites look exactly as before.
  • Fixed the three quick-action buttons on the Dashboard tab, which linked to the wrong page.
  • Renamed the “Panel” tab to “Dashboard”.

1.5.0

  • Added a bundled English translation, so English-language sites show the English interface with no extra plugin.

1.4.2

  • Security: added per-IP rate limiting to the file-attachment upload endpoint, and hardened validation of the primary colour value used by the settings importer.

1.4.0

  • Added close and “reset chat” buttons to the widget header.
  • Added file attachments (image / PDF) to the message composer.
  • Added quantity +/- controls to the cart view.

1.2.0

  • Removed the free-form “Custom CSS” field from the Appearance tab.
  • The “Powered by Tryo Chat” credit is now off by default and opt-in from the General tab.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: chat widget with product search, FAQ and a support request form; WooCommerce integration (add to cart, cart view, featured/on-sale showcase); smart URL-based visibility; settings and FAQ import/export; white-label option; and a simple multi-form builder.
